infographic.title: Ceramic frit band and dot matrix
infographic.description: Two black markings at the glass edge serve different physical functions.

sources.title: Sika Auto Glass Replacement Guideline — ceramic frit

structure.title: The band protects; the dots make the transition gradual
structure.description: Both are fired ceramic enamel, but they do not perform exactly the same role.

sides.title: Solid black band
sides.description: It surrounds the glass bonding zone.

items.title: UV protection
items.description: It protects the polyurethane adhesive from sunlight.

items.title: Hidden bond
items.description: It visually covers the adhesive line and body flange.

sides.title: Dot matrix
sides.description: It fades into the clear glass.

items.title: Thermal ramp
items.description: It reduces the heat-absorption step between black and clear glass during manufacture.

items.title: Visual ramp
items.description: It makes the transition from opaque edge to clear glass less abrupt.
